'''Moon moths''' were nocturnal flying [[Insect/Legends|insects]] with antennae and two thin, [[Color/Legends|powder-blue]]<ref name="Darksaber" /> wings. About 8 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] tall with six legs and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], moon moths were known for their seemingly random flight patterns, and the insects were also particularly tiny, as a moon moth was barely the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] finger. Moon moths were known as pests to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the creatures possessed a prodigious capacity to adapt and breed in any environment: once the [[Species/Legends|species]] arrived on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], it would find a place in the world's ecosystem and begin to thrive. The moth's prevalence made it impossible for [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to determine which planet or [[Star system/Legends|star system]] the moth originated in. Because of the moth's prevalance, [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] developed an [[Moon moth espionage droid|espionage droid of the same name]] that was identical to the moon moth, a trait that made it nearly impossible to differentiate the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from a normal insect.<ref name="Fact File" /> The [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] considered dried moon moths to be a delicacy, and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arjur]] developed a craving for them after spending [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] among the Kubaz.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jedi Cultural Immersion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Moon moths were first mentioned with the appearance of the espionage droid in the novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], and further appearances of the droid have been accompanied by mentions of the insect.
